title: Reminder cron job — send in-app and email reminders for upcoming milestones and todos
description: Daily cron job that checks for milestones and todos due in the next 3 days and on the current day, creates in-app notifications, and sends reminder emails.
acceptanceCriteria: Cron runs daily at 8:00 AM UTC
Finds all incomplete milestones due within 3 days for all users
Finds all incomplete urgent todos due within 3 days
Creates in-app notifications for each (deduplicates: no duplicate notifications for same item same day)
Sends reminder email if user has email_notifications_enabled = true
Email includes CAN-SPAM compliant unsubscribe link

steps.details: Create server/src/jobs/reminders.ts. Export startReminderJob(). Use cron.schedule('0 8 * * *', async () => { ... }). Inside: 1) Query milestones WHERE status != 'completed' AND due_date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '3 days'. Join with projects to get user_id and project name. 2) For each, check if notification already created today (avoid duplicate). 3) Insert into notifications. 4) If user.email_notifications_enabled, send reminder email.
Before inserting notification: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = userId AND type = 'milestone_due' AND ref_id = milestoneId AND created_at > today_start. If count > 0, skip.
Call startReminderJob() in index.ts after DB connection.
Create milestone due tomorrow. Manually invoke the job function. Verify notification created in DB. Verify email sent (check Resend logs).
